digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI / Gerrit Verified workflow
propositions: Gerrit Verified workflow dispatch dominates Actions pool during burst periods; independent patchset changes create 39-job immediate fan-out on Free plan with 20-job concurrency limit
Current workflow structure (13-way full-route fan-out after classification plus mutation shards) causes runnable jobs to queue for 14+ minutes despite no tickets-branch push involvement
macOS job occupies one of five organization-level concurrent slots for 20-30 minutes per full Verified run, creating contention across all navapbc repositories during burst windows

Four mutually exclusive mitigation options differ in slot reduction, latency impact, coverage change, and implementation scope; Option A (bundle preflights and cap mutation to three lanes) reduces peak demand without weakening pre-merge behavior
